body.statement: The standard weighted greedy minimum-hitting-set algorithm is a published logarithmic-factor approximation in the worst case.

source.locator: Appendix F.1, page 50, immediately before Algorithm 11
source.verbatim_statement: It has been shown that this greedy algorithm achieves a logarithmic-factor approximation of the optimal hitting set in the worst case.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Appendix F.1, page 50 of the JMLR PDF at https://jmlr.org/papers/volume26/22-1516/22-1516.pdf.
